name: opsflow-service-desk
description: Full-stack service desk para demonstrar React, TypeScript, API, validação, testes e documentação de produto.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @opsflow/api" "npm run dev -w @opsflow/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @opsflow/domain && npm run test -w @opsflow/api && npm run test -w @opsflow/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @opsflow/domain && npm run typecheck -w @opsflow/api && npm run typecheck -w @opsflow/web
